title: `Escrow.tvl()` does not add in-flight USDC amount
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium    **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `tvl()` function in `HyperliquidEscrow` contract does not include the USDC amount that is currently being bridged (in-flight) when calculating the total value locked (TVL). For other assets, if a bridge is happening in the same block, that amount is added to the TVL. But for USDC, this step is skipped.
